title: ticfac skills get --full prints the skill's references too
description: ticfac skills get ticfac prints only SKILL.md; since #259 the skill has references/ (commands.md, holds.md, cloud.md) that cannot be read from the binary without installing. Add --full (as tk skills get --full does) printing SKILL.md then every references file, each under a header naming its path.
acceptance_criteria: get --full prints SKILL.md and every references/ file; test; make gate
